children: US beverage maker's Q3 net sales rose 3.3% yr/yr, driven by volume gains and new distribution
Gross margin declined due to higher promotional spending and increased freight and packaging costs
Net loss narrowed 43% yr/yr, adjusted EBITDA surged to $10.5 mln
Suja Life sees FY 2026 net sales of $351 mln to $354 mln
Company expects FY 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $68 mln to $70 mln
Company cites continued softness in grocery channel and macroeconomic conditions impacting FY 2026 outlook
VOLUME GAINS AND NEW DISTRIBUTION - Co said net sales growth was primarily driven by increased volumes across key products and expanded distribution
PROMOTIONAL SPENDING - Higher trade investment in response to increased competitive promotional activity weighed on sales and gross margin
HIGHER INPUT COSTS - Gross margin decline attributed to higher inbound freight and packaging costs, as well as unfavorable fixed-cost absorption from lower production volumes
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the non-alcoholic beverages peer group is "hold."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Suja Life Inc is $20.00, about 91.9% above its November 9 closing price of $10.42
